item.title: PropNex caps pivotal year with record earnings, poised for 2026 with robust sales, bigger salesforce
item.description: Singapore’s largest real estate agency PropNex is optimistic about its financial performance in 2026, after having delivered its strongest full-year revenue, earning and dividend in the group’s 25-year history for 2025. Net profit surged 72% y-o-y to $70.4 million last year, on the back of a 42.6% increase in revenue to $1.1 billion, PropNex announced in a bourse filing on Feb 27 morning. item.title: Frasers Property bags The Centrepoint rear plot for $391.9 mil in en bloc sale
item.description: In the year’s first announced collective sale, real estate developer Frasers Property, through its wholly owned subsidiary Frasers Property Cuppage, has been awarded the tender for the leasehold rear plot at The Centrepoint for a consideration of $391.9 million. This consolidates its ownership of the seven-storey landmark property on Singapore’s iconic Orchard Road shopping belt, the group said in a Feb 27 announcement. item.title: Selling with certainty: How Samuel Sim’s strategic framework shapes outcomes for homeowners
item.description: While Singapore’s residential market continues to hold firm, deciding to sell is no longer the hardest part for most homeowners.
